verified_observations.claim: Structured rendering is tolerant of extra entry fields.
Renderer mismatch falls back to raw JSON instead of failing hard.

soft_contract_points: The loader does not validate a strict artifact envelope before dispatching to the renderer.
The read model only requires session_id plus entries[], so entry-level shape is mostly implicit.
No schema version or producer metadata is enforced in the UI.
overfitting_signals: The renderer expects request_id, timestamp, type, prompt_summary, status, and tokens_used field names.
Artifact identity is derived from the filename request_log.json in loadSessionPackage.ts.
visible_gap: Renderer mismatch is displayed inline but not surfaced as telemetry or diagnostics state.
next_step: Add strict envelope validation and emit mismatch diagnostics when the read model does not match.
